observations: Photo 0: Interior of chest freezer lid open, frost/ice buildup visible on galvanized metal walls, unit appears empty.

Photo 1: Front view with lid open, 'Haier THERMOCOOL' logo with a '2 YEARS WARRANTY' badge visible on the door, a single control dial and power switch at bottom right, noticeable rust/corrosion along the bottom edge of the cabinet.
Photo 2: Rear view showing compressor, condenser coil grid, a rating/label sticker (text not legible), rust at bottom corners, and a power plug lying on the floor, not plugged in.
No photo shows the unit powered on, a thermometer reading, or frost forming during operation.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI DAVID EKWERIGBE' present on all photos, consistent with a marketplace listing, not evidence of function.

claims.evidence: Brand confirmed in photo 1, but 'reliable' is a subjective marketing claim not provable from photos.

claims.claim: Strong capacity, long lasting freezing for up to five (days, presumably)
claims.evidence: No photo shows the unit running, cooling, or holding frost under load; interior frost in photo 0 could be residual from prior use or storage, not proof of current function.

risks.risk: Compressor/cooling system may not work or may be inefficient
risks.proof: A video clip of the unit plugged in, running, with a thermometer showing dropping temperature over time

risks.risk: Rust at base and corners may indicate deeper corrosion or refrigerant line damage
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rusted areas and the sealed compressor unit at the back
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic damage with possible structural risk, discounted accordingly

risks.risk: Door/lid seal condition unknown, affecting energy efficiency and cooling retention
risks.proof: Photo of the gasket seal closed and a paper-slip test showing it holds firmly

risks.risk: Age and actual model/capacity unverified, affecting true freezing capacity claims
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating label on the back (photo 2) showing model number, capacity, and year of manufacture
risks.if_unproven: priced at base/generic chest freezer capacity, not any premium spec

proof_requests: Video of the freezer plugged in and running, showing compressor sound and cooling over time
Clear, legible photo of the rating label on the back panel (model, capacity, year)
Close-up photos of the rusted bottom edges and corners
Photo of the door gasket seal intact when closed
response.reason: Brand and item type are clearly identified from photo 1, and visible rust plus absence of any working proof justify pricing this as a used, unverified-condition Haier Thermocool chest freezer at worst case until further proof is supplied.
